metadata.name: duplicate-submit-once
metadata.description: Submit one synthetic event twice through the ordinary UI and independently verify exactly one durable event in routed Test Genie storage.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const form = document.querySelector('[data-testid="calendar-event-editor"]'); if (!form) throw new Error('event editor missing'); form.requestSubmit(); form.requestSubmit(); return 'two synchronous UI submissions dispatched'; })()

expected.stringValue: Saved E1 D2 duplicate synthetic as event

assert.failure_message: Duplicate submission should resolve to a saved event

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const p = new URLSearchParams({start_local_date: '2000-01-01', end_local_date: '2199-12-31'}); const r = await fetch('/api/v1/calendar/events?' + p); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('independent event-list readback failed: ' + r.status); const d = await r.json(); const matches = (d.events || []).filter(e => e.title === 'E1 D2 duplicate synthetic'); if (matches.length !== 1 || matches[0].revision !== 1) throw new Error('expected exactly one durable revision-1 event; found ' + matches.length); return JSON.stringify({count: matches.length, id: matches[0].id, revision: matches[0].revision, title: matches[0].title}); })()

metadata.label: Independent routed durable list readback confirms one event
